sources.institution: University of Dhaka, Department of Statistics
sources.role: Syllabus foundation for B.S. Honours in Statistics (Course Stat H-202 Mathematical Statistics I)

sources.institution: Casella, G. & Berger, R.L. (2002). Statistical Inference (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Foundational treatment of sufficiency, exponential families, sampling distributions, and likelihood theory

sources.institution: Hogg, R.V., McKean, J.W., & Craig, A.T. (2018). Introduction to Mathematical Statistics (8th ed.)
sources.role: Classical reference for normal-sample theory, Cochran's theorem, quadratic forms, and order statistics

sources.institution: Bickel, P.J. & Doksum, K.A. (2015). Mathematical Statistics: Basic Ideas and Selected Topics
sources.role: Rigorous modern mathematical formulation of asymptotic convergence, limit theorems, and delta methods

sources.institution: Lehmann, E.L. & Casella, G. (1998). Theory of Point Estimation (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Authoritative standard for minimal sufficiency, completeness, ancillarity, and Basu's theorem
